content: Data Collection. To build the large ancient-modern Chinese dataset, we collected 1.7K bilingual ancient-modern Chinese articles from the internet. More specifically, a large part of the ancient Chinese data we used come from ancient Chinese history records in several dynasties (about 1000BC-200BC) and articles written by celebrities of that era. They used plain and accurate words to express what happened at that time, and thus ensure the generality of the translated materials.
